options.name: Create Video Draft
options.description: Save a brief and template as a draft conversation for review in Demovela. No recording, rendering or credit spending. Use a new UUID requestId per draft; reuse it only when retrying the exact same draft

options.name: Get Profile
options.description: Read the signed-in customer's own Demovela account profile. Does not search for or identify other people

options.name: Get Video
options.description: Read an existing owned video or draft by ID from list_videos. Download links require product sign-in. Does not start or poll rendering jobs

options.name: Get Video Status
options.description: Read an existing owned video or draft by ID from list_videos. Download links require product sign-in. Does not start or poll rendering jobs

options.name: List Templates
options.description: Browse the video template catalogue with supported formats and descriptions. Does not render or start a recording

options.name: List Videos
options.description: Browse existing outputs and saved video briefs in your workspace. An empty list means no saved videos or drafts
